pages.title: Stochastic Processes
pages.text: $(thing)Stochastic Processes$()$(br2)Chance that unfolds in time: a walk with random steps, a clock with random ticks, a chain whose next state depends only on this one. Unlocks Markov Chain Links, Poisson Clocks and Brownian Suspension.

$(thing)Insight$(): 60$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Distributions.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 2 Normal Distribution Crystal, 2 Dice Set.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): A drunkard takes N steps of length a, each in a direction chosen by chance. Write how far x from the start he typically ends up.
